craChecks.requirement: Maintain a machine-readable SBOM of components (CRA Annex I, Part II).
Apply effective and regular security tests / vulnerability scanning.
Ship without known exploitable vulnerabilities (no Critical at release).
Remediate vulnerabilities without undue delay (track High and above).
Declare the product as the SBOM's top-level component (CycloneDX metadata.component) for traceability (CRA Annex I Part II).
craChecks.note: SBOM declares the product as its top-level component (demo-app@1.0.0).

craChecks.requirement: Record when and by which tool the SBOM was generated (metadata.timestamp + metadata.tools) so it is dated and attributable (CRA Annex I Part II).
craChecks.note: SBOM is missing metadata.timestamp and/or metadata.tools; cannot evidence when/how it was generated.

craChecks.requirement: Give every SBOM component a package identifier (purl/CPE) and a version so it can be matched to vulnerability data (CRA Annex I Part II).
craChecks.note: 2 of 2 components lack a purl/CPE or version (2 missing an identifier, 0 missing a version).

craChecks.requirement: Record component license/SPDX data to enrich the SBOM evidence (SBOM-quality signal; the CRA does not mandate per-component licenses).
craChecks.note: Only 0/2 components carry license/SPDX data (0%). Advisory SBOM enrichment, not a CRA requirement.

craChecks.requirement: Ship with no components affected by known-exploited (CISA KEV) vulnerabilities (CRA Annex I Part I, no known exploitable vulnerabilities).
craChecks.note: Not evaluated: the Grype database in use carries no known-exploited (KEV) enrichment.

craChecks.requirement: Document a mitigation or risk decision for Critical/High findings that have no available upstream fix (CRA Annex I Part I/II).
Apply available security updates: surface High+ findings that already have a fixed version (CRA Annex I Part II, remediate without undue delay).
craChecks.note: 1 High+ finding(s) have an available fixed version still present; apply the security update.

craChecks.requirement: Run vulnerability scans against a recently-updated database, evidencing regular testing (CRA Annex I Part II).
craChecks.note: Scan DB freshness unknown (descriptor.db.built absent or unparseable).

craChecks.requirement: Publish a coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure policy / security contact (SECURITY.md or security.txt) (CRA Annex I Part II points 5-6; Article 13).
craChecks.note: Declared, not verified: only a security contact was declared in the run input. No SECURITY.md or security.txt was supplied, so no policy document was checked.

craChecks.requirement: Provide a machine-discoverable security contact via an RFC 9116 security.txt (CRA Annex I Part II point 6).
craChecks.note: No security.txt at .well-known/security.txt or /security.txt; a SECURITY.md may still satisfy point (6).

factChecks.requirement: Name the manufacturer of the product.
Declare a support period end date (CRA Article 13(8) sets a minimum support period, normally five years from placing on the market).
factChecks.note: Support period end declared as 2099-12-31. Whether it meets the Article 13(8) minimum depends on the placing-on-market date, which this run does not know.

factChecks.requirement: The SBOM's top-level component should be the product you declared.
factChecks.note: The SBOM's top-level component matches the declared product.
